title: Another Successful Sale by FYI Yachts | 59' Marquis
description: FYI Yachts is proud to announce the successful sale of the 2006 59′ Marquis, another outstanding transaction that highlights the firm’s continued success in the boating and yachting market. Ricardo Llorente of FYI Yachts represented both the buyer and the seller, serving as the Listing Broker and Selling Broker for this successful transaction. The 59′ Marquis is celebrated for its timeless design, spacious accommodations, and impressive performance, making it a highly sought-after yacht for owners seeking both luxury cruising and exceptional onboard comfort. Representing both sides of the transaction reflects Ricardo Llorente’s extensive market expertise, strong client relationships, and commitment to providing a seamless brokerage experience from start to finish. “This successful sale reflects the confidence our clients place in FYI Yachts and our commitment to delivering exceptional results,” said Ricardo Llorente. “It was a pleasure representing both the buyer and seller throughout the process, and I wish the new owners many unforgettable years aboard their Marquis.” The FYI Yachts team congratulates everyone involved in the transaction and wishes the new owners countless memorable adventures aboard their new yacht.
